InboxState.description: Per-user inbox state for a channel: mute and hide flags, unread counters, and read pointers.

items.description: Identifier of an inbox section. System ids: `all`, `direct`, `group`, `external`, `mentions`. Custom ids are user-defined.

mentionUnreadCount.description: Number of unread mentions of the current user.

lastReadVisibleSeq.description: Highest `visibleSeq` the user has read in this channel.

lastReadTimelineSeq.description: Timeline anchor paired with lastReadVisibleSeq: a timelineSeq near the read boundary, so a client can load a bounded message window and jump to the first unread. Exact when the cursor was set from a resolved message (MarkRead with messageId, message.new, member add, repair, or a tail read); best-effort on the legacy visibleSeq-only MarkRead and unreadMarkAt MarkUnread paths, where the prior value is retained and may lag or lead lastReadVisibleSeq. Absent until the cursor is first written. Treat as a positioning hint, not an exact bound.

lastReadAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent read event.

hidden.description: True when the channel is hidden (archived).

muted.description: True when the channel is muted.

mutedUntil.description: Expiry timestamp for a temporary mute.

pinned.description: True when the user has pinned this channel.

pinnedAt.description: When the user pinned this channel, stamped once at pin time and unchanged by later activity. Absent whenever `pinned` is false, and on the rare pinned row whose pin instant predates pin-time sort ordering.

unreadMarkAt.description: `visibleSeq` from which the user manually marked the channel as unread.

Section.description: Inbox section with metadata, channel count, and unread counters.

sectionId.description: Identifier of an inbox section. System ids: `all`, `direct`, `group`, `external`, `mentions`. Custom ids are user-defined.

channelCount.description: Total channels assigned to this section.

unmutedUnreadChannelCount.description: Unmuted channels with at least one unread message.

unmutedUnreadMessageCount.description: Total unread messages across unmuted channels.

mutedUnreadMessageCount.description: Total unread messages across muted channels.

unreadMentionCount.description: Unread direct mentions of the current user.

SectionType.description: Whether the section is system-managed or user-defined.
